column1: # Cached values replaced by golden oracle cells of the same formula on the same inputs (decision 0032).
# Kept subnormals that Excel saves as 0 (decision 0090): C10 is =10^(-307) and C11 is =-10^(-307) in both
# workbooks, so C10+C11 is 6E-323, which Excel keeps (no near-zero snap: the 8-ULP bound is subnormal,
# numbers.md "Near-zero snapping in addition and subtraction") and writes as <v>0</v>. The probe rows hold
# the same formulas, with FALSE (x)=0 companions (K130, K131; J130 and J131 read the cells themselves). T-2714.
# Cached values the corpus anonymisation broke (decision 0133, T-2867). pv26_020 and its byte-identical
# twin pv26_2_020: the anonymisation renamed the text in Summary!B17 to Company0691 but left the sheet it
# names as ConAgra, so the shipped workbook has no Company0691 sheet. C17:O17 are INDIRECT($B17&"!Name")
# and M23:O26 MAX/AVERAGE/MEDIAN/MIN(M7:M21) over them; the probe holds the same formulas over the same
# B17 text, with the other rows of M7:O21 as their cached INDIRECT results. Excel gives #REF! for all.
# pv26_010 Cover!C16 is saved as <f ca="1">45678</f> with no value: the anonymisation replaced a
# volatile formula by a literal and dropped its value. The probe cell is =45678.
